svg.aria-label: Isometric model of agentic AI on a 4G and 5G network: a person at a desk types or speaks a request to a round AI agent; the agent calls a CAMARA network API gateway with four modules (geofencing, location verification, quality on demand, population density) that runs on a Sylva-aligned telco cloud of Kubernetes racks with a Git ledger and a Flux line; two base stations serve a geofenced area with an older person's phone, a payment terminal inside its zone, a phone with a reserved quality lane and a crowd over a density grid.
